Name: Coffee Replacer
Author: lamplight12347
Description:
This is my first mod!

All it does is replace the coffee cup texture (not the drinking animation sadly, maybe in a future update?)
Requires Content Patcher!

If you're like me you have a TON of features in your game, well I was tired of the vanilla coffee cup and decided to replace it with my own! If you have any other suggestions for what I should replace let me know!

Manifest.Name: Coffee Replacer!
Manifest.Description: Replaces coffee cup with a sligtly fancier one
